sections.title: A. Your four complete positive demonstrations
sections.intro: Run Protect → Verify → Compare for each row. D1–D4 are the only payload/cover combinations in scope.

cases.files: Cover: samples/covers/astronaut.png; payload: Short example button in Text message mode.
cases.steps: Depth 1; manual offset 100; complete all three phases.
cases.expected: Protect fits; output stego_image.png. Verify Authentic and exact short text. Image Compare succeeds; max difference ≤1; histograms/difference views render.

cases.files: Cover: samples/audio/sample-006.wav; payload: Long example button (or paste samples/text/sample-019.txt).
cases.steps: Depth 2; manual offset 100; complete all three phases.
cases.expected: Protected package fits within 3975 B with defaults; output stego_audio.wav. Verify Authentic and full message preserved. Audio Compare succeeds; max sample difference ≤3; waveform/SNR evidence.

cases.steps: Depth 1; manual offset 100; review 24044 B payload plus overhead before creation; complete three phases.
cases.expected: Fits within 98291 B; PNG output; Verify Authentic and exact recovered WAV, audio preview/download available. Image Compare succeeds; max difference ≤1.

cases.steps: Depth 4; manual offset 100; complete all three phases.
cases.expected: 2650 B PNG plus overhead fits within 7950 B; WAV output; Verify Authentic and exact recovered PNG with image preview/download. Audio Compare succeeds; max difference ≤15.

sections.title: B. Four focused Protect/settings checks
sections.intro: These reuse the same four combinations. Save alternate valid outputs separately; do not overwrite the baseline files.

cases.description: D3: cover too small, then sufficient depth
cases.steps: Review depth 1/index 100; then depth 3/index 100. Create and Verify the depth-3 output if it fits.
cases.expected: Depth 1: no fit (10019 B capacity <24044 B payload even before overhead); create disabled. Depth 3: 30058 B capacity, expected fit with defaults; selected depth retained; Verify Authentic at depth 3.

cases.description: D4: insufficient LSB capacity, then correct depth
cases.expected: Depth 1 fails (1987 B <2650 B payload); create disabled/no silent depth change. Depth 4 fits; Verify with depth 4 returns Authentic.

cases.description: D1: alternate LSB depth and start index
cases.steps: Protect at depth 2/index 200; Review/create; manually Verify depth 2/index 200; Compare.
cases.expected: Fits, retains 2 LSBs and index 200; Authentic; Compare max difference ≤3. Demonstrates offset and depth must agree on both sides.

cases.steps: Review index 786431 (last valid channel), then 786432 (outside carrier). Restore 100 afterward.
cases.expected: 786431: valid index but insufficient capacity/no fit. 786432: outside-cover-range error (0..786431). Neither creates a new stego object; no crash.

sections.title: C. Five focused Verify negative checks
sections.intro: Use saved baselines and change only one variable. Each test must produce a non-Authentic result. Restore correct settings/key/file afterward.

cases.files: Saved original D2 stego WAV; matching Alice public key.
cases.steps: Verify depth 1/index 100 instead of encoded depth 2. Then restore depth 2.
cases.expected: Wrong depth: normally Payload Missing / NO_RECOGNISED_PAYLOAD; accidental recognizable marker could lead Cannot Verify, but not Authentic. Restored depth 2: Authentic.

cases.files: Saved original D3 stego PNG; matching public key.
cases.steps: Verify depth 1/index 101 or 1000 instead of 100. Then restore 100.
cases.expected: Wrong offset normally Payload Missing / NO_RECOGNISED_PAYLOAD; marker cannot be read. Restore 100: Authentic. Do not expect a distinct Wrong Start Location verdict.

cases.steps: Correct depth 4/index 100; click Use wrong key (negative case); verify. Reload matching public key and verify again.
cases.expected: Wrong key: Signature Invalid / SIGNATURE_INVALID; decryption/hashes may still pass; any displayed recovered image is untrusted. Correct key: Authentic.

cases.files: Recreate D1 so it is LAST CREATED; trusted public key.
cases.steps: Click Alter cover value; Verify modified copy at depth 1/manual 100. Then Restore original stego and verify again.
cases.expected: Modified copy: Tampered / COVER_HASH_MISMATCH; signature/content hash/decryption pass; cover check fails. Restored original: Authentic.

cases.files: Recreate D2 so it is LAST CREATED; trusted public key.
cases.steps: Click Alter hidden content; Verify modified copy at depth 2/manual 100. Restore original stego and verify again.
cases.expected: Modified copy: Cannot Verify / DECRYPTION_FAILED; no recovered content because AES-GCM fails. This is not expected to be Tampered. Restored original: Authentic.

sections.title: D. Three focused Compare checks
sections.intro: The positive comparisons are already part of D1–D4; only these additional edge cases are needed.

cases.files: Original field: samples/covers/chelsea.png; stego field: saved D1 stego PNG.
cases.steps: Compare objects; then replace original with astronaut.png and compare again.
cases.expected: Wrong pair rejected: Objects must have matching dimensions/channels or audio format/duration. Correct original: successful D1 comparison.

cases.files: Original field: samples/audio/sample-002.wav; stego field: saved D2 stego WAV.
cases.steps: Compare objects; then replace original with sample-006.wav and compare again.
cases.expected: Wrong pair rejected with same matching-properties message; rates/frame counts differ. Correct original: successful audio comparison.

cases.files: samples/covers/astronaut.png in BOTH fields; optionally repeat sample-006.wav in both fields.
cases.expected: Changed values=0, changed%=0, MSE=0, max difference=0; PSNR shows Identical. Optional audio: SNR inf (stego is identical to the cover). No authenticity verdict is inferred.
